title: PXAPI analysis run request v1
description: The accepted request artifact that started an Analysis Run (Confluence 39846055 §1, §14, §15; 40239107 §5): which website is to be analysed, through which input channel the request arrived and which delivery channels were asked for. The document is privacy-minimal by construction: it never carries an e-mail address, a name or a credential — the requester and the contact are opaque references held by the adapter that raised the request, and both are optional non-null, so their absence means only that no reference was supplied. The channel is an opaque token, not a closed vocabulary; the target URL is a structural shape only, with reachability and egress policy enforced elsewhere; an empty delivery_channels array means no delivery was requested and the run rests at READY.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this request belongs to.

request_id.description: Required. The stable identity of the request artifact; the internal analysis record references it.

requested_at.description: Required. When the request was raised.

target_url.description: Required. The website to analyse, as an absolute http or https URL in structural shape only. Reachability, canonicalisation and egress policy are not contract concerns and are enforced elsewhere.

channel.description: Required. The input channel that raised the request, as an opaque producer-defined token (e.g. internal, self_service). The vocabulary is deliberately not closed in v1.

requester_ref.description: Optional. An opaque reference to the requesting identity — an API key owner, an operator or a self-service request context — as held by the adapter that raised the request. Absent means no requester reference was supplied.

contact_ref.description: Optional. An opaque reference to a contact or recipient context held by a delivery adapter. Never an e-mail address, a name or any other personal datum: the contract carries references only. Absent means no contact reference was supplied.

delivery_channels.description: Required. The delivery channels requested for the run, as opaque channel tokens (e.g. email), each at most once. An empty array means no delivery was requested: the run rests at READY.
